A FEW COMMON QUESTIONS

Good question.

And if yours isn’t here,
we’re happy to have a chat.

Ask us anything
Do I need to know what software I need?

Not at all. Tell us what you’re trying to do, or what’s slowing you down. We’ll help you work out a practical next step and explain it in plain English.

How much will it cost?

It depends on the job. We’ll give you a free, fixed-price quote for the agreed work before we start. Any hosting or other ongoing costs will be set out too, so you can make a proper decision.

Can you help with a small job?

Absolutely. A website change, a better invoice template or one repetitive job taken off your hands is a perfectly good place to start.

Can you work with the tools I already use?

Often, yes. Let us know what you use and what you want to improve. We’ll check what’s possible before recommending a change or a new build.

What happens once the work is finished?

We walk you through it and make sure you know how to use it. If you’d like ongoing help, our optional $50/month Sunday Care Plan covers maintenance and agreed small changes. The quote sets out the details for your project.

Why Sunday?

Because there are better things to do on a Sunday than catch up on paperwork. A little less admin means a little more time for yourself.
